baseCohortDefinition.name: Missed appointments (excluding dead and transferred out)

config.sql: SELECT DISTINCT o1.person_id FROM obs o1 WHERE o1.person_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT o2.person_id FROM obs o2 WHERE o2.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid IN ('dd27a783-30ab-102d-86b0-7a5022ba4115', 'fc1b1e96-4afb-423b-87e5-bb80d451c967')) AND o2.obs_datetime BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate AND o2.voided = 0) AND o1.concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = 'dcac04cf-30ab-102d-86b0-7a5022ba4115') AND o1.value_datetime BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate AND o1.voided = 0
